compiled_state.title: As an operator running any remediation touchpoint, I want preplanning Phase E, impl-plan Steps 2/4/6, and sprint verifier-fail sites to embed the shared loop protocol with correct cascade-mapped upstream
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Embed the loop logic at each touchpoint per Option A. Preplanning Phase E uses upstream=brainstorm on REPLAN_ESCALATE; impl-plan Steps 2/4/6 use upstream=preplanning; sprint verifier-fail uses the planner's escalation_upstream resolved dynamically from the planner's output (per the shared-protocol enum's planner_supplied value). Each embedding emits "Current cycle: N of MAX_CYCLES" at iteration start, runs /dso:oscillation-check as a hard gate on cycle >= 2 (or records OSCILLATION_CHECK_SKIPPED: <reason> in the ticket comment), and respects the HALT-vs-REPLAN exclusivity invariant.

**Why**: SC4 — the shared protocol from the SC4 protocol-doc story must be applied at each touchpoint. Without this, callers can dispatch decomposers but the loop semantics (cycle declaration, termination, oscillation gate, exclusivity) are not enforced.

**Scope**:
- IN: Loop embedding in /dso:preplanning Phase E, /dso:implementation-plan Steps 2/4/6 (3 sites), /dso:sprint verifier-fail handler
- IN: Three SC4 fixtures: forced-failing-review fixture, oscillation fixture, HALT-vs-REPLAN exclusivity fixture
- IN: Mid-loop success-exit fixture (success on cycle 2 of MAX_CYCLES=3 → no further cycles, no REPLAN_ESCALATE)
- IN: PROTOCOL_ERROR fixture (REPLAN_ESCALATE emitted at cycle < MAX_CYCLES or HALT_FOR_USER co-emitted with REPLAN_ESCALATE → emit PROTOCOL_ERROR)
- IN: Dynamic-upstream wiring for sprint verifier-fail (reads planner's escalation_upstream field at runtime)
- OUT: Shared protocol definitions (delivered by SC4 protocol-doc story — depended on)
- OUT: Caller-side dispatches per touchpoint (delivered by the per-touchpoint wiring stories — depended on)

**Split candidate**: Yes — if the combined embedding work exceeds one sub-agent session, /dso:implementation-plan may split per-touchpoint (Phase E vs impl-plan Steps 2/4/6 vs sprint verifier-fail).

## Done Definitions

- At every touchpoint (preplanning Phase E, impl-plan Steps 2/4/6, sprint verifier-fail sites), the loop emits 'Current cycle: N of MAX_CYCLES' at the start of each iteration
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Forced-failing-review fixture passes at each touchpoint: exactly MAX_CYCLES dispatches occur, no cycle MAX_CYCLES+1 dispatch occurs, and the terminal emission is REPLAN_ESCALATE: <upstream>. For the sprint verifier-fail touchpoint specifically, the fixture asserts that <upstream> equals the planner's escalation_upstream field from the matched decision-tree branch (e.g., replan_story → preplanning, replan_epic → brainstorm); hardcoded constants at the sprint touchpoint are non-compliant
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Oscillation fixture passes: /dso:oscillation-check runs as a hard gate on cycle >= 2, OSCILLATION_HALT is emitted on detected oscillation, and skipping requires an OSCILLATION_CHECK_SKIPPED: <reason> ticket comment
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- HALT-vs-REPLAN exclusivity fixture passes: REPLAN_ESCALATE is only emitted when cycle_count == MAX_CYCLES AND findings is non-empty; HALT_FOR_USER and REPLAN_ESCALATE never co-occur in the same cycle
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Mid-loop success-exit fixture passes: review passes on cycle 2 of MAX_CYCLES=3 → loop emits success and continues without further cycles, no REPLAN_ESCALATE
  ← Satisfies: sc-4
- PROTOCOL_ERROR fixture passes: simulate REPLAN_ESCALATE emitted at cycle < MAX_CYCLES (or HALT_FOR_USER co-emitted with REPLAN_ESCALATE) → touchpoint emits PROTOCOL_ERROR token, not the partial state
  ← Satisfies: sc-4

## Considerations

- [Composition] The HALT_FOR_USER path is owned by the SC3 sprint-verifier-fail-wiring story (planner LOW confidence); this story owns REPLAN_ESCALATE, OSCILLATION_HALT, and PROTOCOL_ERROR. Coordinate the state machine across the two stories so exclusivity holds at runtime.
- [Risk] Embedding the loop inline at each touchpoint risks drift from the shared protocol doc; the protocol-conformance harness from the SC4 protocol-doc story MUST be invoked from every touchpoint's tests.
- [Maintainability] 5 touchpoint embeddings (Phase E + 3 impl-plan steps + 1 sprint verifier-fail) in one story is borderline-large. If implementation context pressure surfaces, request a split via REPLAN_ESCALATE rather than abbreviating fixtures.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
